message_analysis: Crystal clear single message: AI code review agents are mandatory in 2026 because human review is broken and costly. Every scene reinforces this — the $2.3M hook establishes stakes, Scene 2 proves the problem is real (60% accuracy drop), Scene 3 delivers the solution, Scene 4 quantifies the gap (35% faster, 50% fewer bugs), Scene 5 frames it as effortless scaling, Scene 6 loops back to prove the agent would have caught the original disaster. No filler. The angle (code reviews are 'silently killing' velocity) is sharp and original — positions a dev tool as a velocity multiplier, not a compliance checkbox. Message is strong enough developers will share this to their teams.
